Definition: properly, to prostrate; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be shattered, be dismayed, be broken, be abolished, be afraid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be shattered, be broken; 1a2) to be dismayed; 1b) (Niphal) to be broken, be dismayed; 1c) (Piel) to be shattered, be dismayed, be scared; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cause to be dismayed; 1d2) to dismay, terrify; 1d3) to shatter
